body: User: opening https://www.iso20022.org/sites/default/files/ISO10383_MIC/ISO10383_MIC.csv just redirects to chrome-extension://.../src/app/index.html. Cause: useUrlSync deletes ?openFile/?intercept after hydrate, before pickupIntercept reads location.search. Fix: snapshot intake params at module load in intercept.ts.
title: Remote CSV openFile redirect lands on blank viewer
